versions.name: Camp Cedars
versions.address: 2898 Tom Lee Rd Cedar Bluffs, Nebraska 68015

features.note: A lakefront and boat house on the camp reservoir.
An equestrian center on the property.
Permanent tent platforms across twelve campsites.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/326-Cedars26); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. The page is not recently updated, which is fine here: it is used for durable description, not sessions or fees. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
